create_unified_radial_mlp: create a UnifiedRadialMLP from a list of RadialMLP modules using the factory function
build_UnifiedRadialMLP: build a UnifiedRadialMLP instance by passing a list of RadialMLP modules with identical architecture
run_UnifiedRadialMLP_forward: run the forward pass of UnifiedRadialMLP on an input tensor to get all radial outputs
test_validate_radial_mlp: test the _validate_radial_mlp function to check a RadialMLP has the expected 7-layer structure
review_UnifiedRadialMLP_umas_radial_mlp: review the umas_radial_mlp method that applies layers 2+ with layer norm and SiLU activations
